content.comment_body: Has anyone used [product_name] in high voltage substations? Is it secure for this kind of application? I am considering using [product_name] 230 RC in a high voltage substation.

Hello, I have not personally used [product_name] in high voltage substations, but if you provide the required certification, I might be able to assist further. Alternatively, please describe the electromagnetic environment so I can help identify the correct specification for your certification needs. Goodbye, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], For high voltage substations, electronic devices should comply with this standard: IEC 61000-6-5: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) – Part 6-5: Generic Standards – Immunity for Power Station and Substation Environments. I have reviewed the technical data of [product_name] and found it complies with some sections of IEC 61000. I also noticed in the technical data that the digital inputs of [product_name] are not electrically isolated. Typically, devices used in high voltage substations are electrically isolated. Do you think this could cause malfunction of [product_name] in such environments?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are assessing the suitability of [product_name] for high voltage substations, focusing on EMC compliance and whether the lack of electrical isolation in digital inputs could lead to operational issues in environments with high electromagnetic interference. There is uncertainty about whether the product meets the stringent requirements for use in critical power station applications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to meet all EMC standards for high voltage substations and to offer features like electrically isolated digital inputs to ensure reliable and safe operation in challenging environments.
